info.title: Kufr device backend API
info.description: Device authentication, conversations, transcription, text turns, operation polling/cancellation, speech, audio and cleanup. This API returns data and never commands physical actuators. Sensitive responses use Cache-Control: no-store.

get.summary: Latest tail or ascending cursor pages of bounded metadata; no conversation content

200.description: Technical metadata only, no AI calls; no-store.

get.summary: Read server modes and active count with a read-only log credential

200.description: Technical metadata only, no AI calls; no-store.

get.summary: Read global runtime modes and provider availability without provider calls

200.description: Confirmed state; modes last until restart, then deployment configuration applies

put.summary: Change global modes using an observed revision when no conversation or provider call is active

200.description: Confirmed state or no-op; no provider call is made

409.description: mode_revision_mismatch, conversations_active or provider_unavailable; refresh before another change

get.summary: Read configured provider modes without invoking AI

200.description: Authenticated metadata only; no secrets or conversation content

post.summary: Exchange a provisioned device credential for a scoped access token

200.description: Device access token valid for 15 minutes

post.summary: Submit one text turn for asynchronous processing

202.description: Existing or newly accepted operation; the same idempotency key and body return the same operation

post.summary: Submit one PCM16 mono 32 kHz WAV recording for transcription
post.description: At most 30 seconds and 1.92 MiB of samples plus a small WAV header; upload is streamed without base64. The operation is tied to the current device, conversation and generation.

post.summary: Stream a bounded PTT voice turn through the authenticated backend
post.description: Requires responses/openai modes and audio consent. JSON body up to 2600000 bytes; input WAV is PCM16 mono 32 kHz, 100 ms to 30 s. The provider receives resampled 24 kHz PCM. NDJSON starts with started, then audio/visitor events, then exactly one completed/failed event. Each line is below 64 KiB; output PCM is at most 1440000 bytes. No replay of paid sound; retry returns 409. Audio is provisional; only completed carries an accepted proposal. Stop, disconnect or the 45 s deadline cancels generation.

200.description: Newline-delimited JSON events; each event conforms to RealtimeEvent

post.summary: Synthesize the server-validated reply from an existing turn
post.description: Client text is never accepted by this operation. Only one output target plays at a time.

get.summary: Read a device-owned operation without starting another provider call

200.description: Current operation state; result may expire without a provider replay

delete.summary: Cancel client interest and suppress publication of a late result
delete.description: A provider request already sent may still be charged. Cancellation does not retry or regenerate it.

get.summary: Download a short-lived device-owned audio result

200.description: At most 30 seconds of PCM16 mono 32 kHz WAV, retained at most 120 seconds

delete.summary: End a device-owned conversation and erase in-memory sensitive content

post.summary: Suitcase speaks first without a visitor message; only before the first turn

202.description: Existing or newly accepted operation; the same idempotency key and body return the same operation

get.summary: Read current device evening ID and storage counters; no transcript content
List up to 100 named evenings for the authenticated device without transcript content

200.description: Active ID and bounded profile summaries

post.summary: Create and activate a named evening with compare-and-switch; replay retained for 24 hours, up to 1024 keys per device

put.summary: Activate an existing evening for this device with compare-and-switch

delete.summary: Erase device evening and cancel its current conversations; stale IDs are a harmless no-op

204.description: Expected evening erased or already absent; later evenings are preserved

post.description: Fresh session with gpt-live-1 client delegation to the existing Sol backend. Reserve 3 USD for the entire session before connecting; maximum 180 seconds. speed must be 1. Continuous input uses one inputId and sequence for the entire session, including while output plays. Events: session, started, listening, audio/visitor/pause/heartbeat, speech_stopped, completed, closed. pause is output PCM segmentation, not provider audio-done. completed follows validated final backend selection and session.closed with final cumulative duration usage. Caller confirms playback before closed. Stop/disconnect cancels all work. No replay; uncertain final usage retains reservation.

200.description: Continuous NDJSON GptLiveEvent; at most 20 MB, individual lines below 64 KiB.

post.description: PCM16 mono 24 kHz, 2 to 9600 even bytes, at most 1440000 bytes per turn. Input-Sequence starts at zero. One upload in flight; never retry ambiguous delivery. Frames for the just-ended inputId are acknowledged and discarded. The stream, conversation and authenticated device must match.

204.description: Frame accepted once or discarded after VAD stop

post.summary: Acknowledge actual completion of native audio playback
post.description: A body of at most 512 bytes identifies the exact completed operation. Duplicate acknowledgements are harmless. The next listening event can arrive before this HTTP response, so clients must reset their input state before sending.

204.description: Playback acknowledged; next turn can be reserved

post.summary: Stream a bounded hands-free conversation with automatic voice activity detection
post.description: A fresh conversation and opening=true are required. JSON start is at most 4096 bytes. One provider connection stays open for at most 8 minutes and 10 turns, with a 45 second turn deadline. The server reserves each turn before accepting input; VAD uses 650 ms silence without automatic provider responses. NDJSON session carries streamId; listening carries a new inputId. Upload ordered PCM16 mono 24 kHz to audio. speech_stopped closes input, started/audio/visitor/completed follow. After playback, acknowledge the exact operationId at played within 35 seconds; only then is the next turn reserved. Audio is provisional and completed carries the validated result and conservative cost. Heartbeats occur every 10 seconds. DELETE conversation, stream disconnect or background cancels all work. No paid stream/audio replay, no direct actuation. PTT clients keep realtime-turns.

200.description: NDJSON RealtimeLiveEvent lines below 64 KiB; at most 20 MB per stream

post.description: PCM16 mono 24 kHz, 2 to 9600 even bytes, at most 1440000 bytes per turn. Input-Sequence starts at zero. One upload in flight; never retry ambiguous delivery. Frames for the just-ended inputId are acknowledged and discarded. The stream, conversation and authenticated device must match.

204.description: Frame accepted once or discarded after VAD stop

post.summary: Acknowledge actual completion of native audio playback
post.description: A body of at most 512 bytes identifies the exact completed operation. Duplicate acknowledgements are harmless. The next listening event can arrive before this HTTP response, so clients must reset their input state before sending.

204.description: Playback acknowledged; next turn can be reserved

LogReader.description: Separate read-only credential; no device token, AI invocation or mutations

ServerAdmin.description: Separate server admin credential; neither ESP device credentials nor access tokens grant this authority

DeviceCredential.description: Unique service-provisioned device credential, never placed in a URL or firmware image

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID bound to device, route and request-body hash; different content with the same key returns 409. Content-free record retained for 24 hours.

AcceptedOperation.description: Existing or newly accepted asynchronous operation for the idempotency key and body

Problem.description: ProblemDetails with a stable code and trace identifier; no prompt, token or provider secret

wav.description: PCM16 mono 32 kHz, at most 30 seconds; reject oversized or malformed WAV before provider use

name.description: 1 to 80 Unicode scalar values; controls and blank-only names rejected
